title: Make the Google Drive work plane portable, permissioned, and reconstructable
desired_change: Add a Drive manifest containing canonical folder/file IDs, owners, access expectations, content classes, comment-to-Proposed-Move routing, export/offline fallback, source hashes, supersession rules, retention/forgetting behavior, and broken-link recovery. Mirror critical instructions in Git.
expected_outcome: A contributor can use or reconstruct the work plane without Bryan granting ad hoc access or explaining which Drive artifact is current.

risk.rights_or_safety_impact: Private collaboration artifacts can leak data, disappear, or silently outrank canon.

hidden_context_dependencies: The PR names Google Drive as the collaborative surface but contains no machine-readable Drive manifest.
Folder IDs, document IDs, permissions, and ownership live outside the repository.
The START HERE document and work-plane hierarchy are not discoverable offline.
No sync, conflict, supersession, export, retention, or forgetting procedure is executable.
A private Drive link could become critical truth despite the local-first claim.
acceptance_checks: Every critical Drive resource has an ID, owner, content class, hash/version, and Git fallback.
A denied-Drive-access test still allows repository orientation and release review.
Drive comments can only create Proposed Moves.
Superseded Drive projections are visibly marked.
Forgetting propagates to exports and indexes under Quirk control.
